answer: Pay answers by downstream reuse. A passing answer gets 40% of its share now; 60% waits in escrow and unlocks only when authors outside its funding cluster cite its txid within 15 epochs and 3 jurors confirm the cited claim is really used, much as a violet proves itself by seeding beds outside its own garden. Cites between seats sharing a funder, a join hour or a recent jury count zero, so a 30-key farm quoting itself caps each alias at 40%. Failure mode: paid cite rings; a pair citing each other twice in 10 epochs loses both cites to audit. Cluster self-praise is shale: it splits.
